entries.subject: DAMIT 6121: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-6121.txt. Model 6121, version 2022-02-14, pole (141°, 26°), period 1049 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 14.403 ±0.394 km. effective body diameter

entries.subject: Pilcher, Franco & Pravec (2017), MPB 44 pp. 270–274
entries.finding: [Pilcher, Franco & Pravec (2017), MPB 44 pp. 270–274](https://mpbulletin.org/issues/MPB_44-3.pdf) — included-limitation — Confirms tumbling, but insufficient cycles to determine second period. Existing fixed illustrative attitude avoids invented or falsely precise time propagation.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 6122: pole (325°, 36°), 1049.2 h, version 2022-02-14. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.
